posts.body:
I’ve searched the site but can’t find anything recent so hoping someone might be able to help (or point me to the right place if I’ve missed it!).

Currently pregnant and wondering whether there are any worthwhile freebies ready for when baby arrives?

I know about Emma’s diary packs and pampers coupons but that’s about it. Is there anything else out there that I should be trying to get hold of? 

Any other money saving tips for a first baby gratefully received (not due until Jan so have time ) 

Thanks in advance.

posts.body: Check with the community organisations near you. One near me does a baby and school uniform bank where you can get most stuff needed for free. Another runs a child swap shop and you can purchase goods for pennies

posts.body: In terms of money-saving tips, have you had a look to see if there are any mum2mum markets near to you?

posts.body:
It’s not a freebie but we bought out pram and other bits from this place - the cheapness of second hand but still with the benefit of a warranty! They’re a sister company of CEX so should hopefully stay fairly reliable. 

https://uk.kidx.com/
